firstRun.limitation: Original harness emitted no error detail. Its exact transient failure cause was not retained; it is not reported as a proven product or transport defect. Read-only lookup afterwards confirmed the original receipt and record persisted.

boundedResume.method: One-off local recovery using the same synthetic child, records, original operations and real Better Auth. Existing synthetic session token was re-signed for the replacement harness secret; no auth bypass or new session/account. HTTP connections explicitly closed between requests.
